summary: PRIMARY_SOURCE_PRIOR_INSUFFICIENT. The three-paper audit cannot be sealed because primary source B was not readable through its DOI, publisher, author-linked publisher route, or author-posted paper route; all returned access denial rather than primary content, and search snippets were excluded. Source A establishes contemporaneous short-interval order-flow price impact in equities, not forward alpha. Source C establishes multi-venue Bitcoin leader-lag predictability at 500/1000 ms, not a single OKX BTC-USDT spot claim at 15/60 minutes. The frozen V3 next-complete-minute entry, matched controls, simplest-first tier selection, 15/60-minute screen, and separate later 30-bps economic route correctly guard the identified causal and economic gaps, but literature support for the exact OKX transfer remains unsealed. Immediate PnL and drawdown effects are zero.

Branch, HEAD, origin, cleanliness, containment, regular-file/non-reparse type, and all nine non-null repository hashes matched.

checks.name: PRIMARY_SOURCE_A_CONTEMPORANEOUS_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: The full primary paper [Cont, Kukanov and Stoikov](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1011.6402) models same-interval short-horizon mid-price changes as a function of concurrent order-flow imbalance and depth, explicitly describing instantaneous/contemporaneous impact. This supports a price-formation mechanism prior only and is not evidence of later 15/60-minute tradable alpha.

checks.name: PRIMARY_SOURCE_B_ACCESS_AND_SCOPE
checks.evidence: The exact [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.finmar.2026.101047), publisher page, author-linked publisher route, and author-posted paper route returned access denial rather than readable primary content. The [University of Guelph author page](https://www.uoguelph.ca/profile/nikola-gradojevic) confirms the paper identity and publisher link only. Search-result snippets were not used. Therefore its daily cross-sectional world-order-flow design and predictive findings were not independently audited.

checks.name: PRIMARY_SOURCE_C_MULTI_VENUE_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: The full primary paper [Albers et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2108.09750) uses microstructural features across 14 fragmented Bitcoin markets, constructs a leader-lagger network, and evaluates 500/1000 ms future returns. It directly supports a cross-market asynchronous-information mechanism, while leaving a single OKX spot venue and 15/60-minute transfer MISSING_PROOF.

checks.name: CURRENT_V3_CONTRACT_ALIGNMENT
checks.evidence: Frozen repository bytes separate signal-minute completion from NEXT_COMPLETE_MINUTE_OPEN, require point-in-time completeness and at least 80% strictly earlier same-minute matched controls, screen fixed 15- and 60-minute horizons, select only the first passing simplest tier, prohibit outcome-driven tier/horizon/threshold changes, and defer fee/slippage/PnL evidence to a separate 30-bps economic route. No contract byte was changed or proposed.

checks.name: PERMITTED_CAUSAL_CLAIM_LABEL
checks.evidence: Permitted label: PRIMARY_LITERATURE_MECHANISM_PLAUSIBLE_BUT_EXACT_OKX_15_60_MINUTE_FORWARD_TRANSFER_UNSEALED. Neither contemporaneous impact nor cross-venue sub-second prediction is labelled single-venue OKX forward alpha.

checks.name: PERFORMANCE_DRAWDOWN_AND_COST_GAPS
checks.evidence: Exact OKX predictive value, statistical significance, cross-venue causal origin, fee-adjusted PnL, drawdown, 30-bps survivability, fills, slippage, capacity, and deployment behavior were not established. No performance value was recomputed or inferred.

checks.name: OPPORTUNITY_COST_ASSESSMENT
checks.evidence: Failing closed avoids treating contemporaneous equity impact or multi-venue sub-second cross-impact as proof for one OKX spot 15/60-minute lane. The cost is that the prior cannot be closed before evidence interpretation until source B is directly auditable; preserving the frozen V3 gates avoids both byte churn and outcome-driven rescue.

checks.name: FINAL_ZERO_CHANGE_SAFETY_GATE
checks.evidence: Final branch, HEAD, and origin remained codex/autonomous-research-control-plane-v3 at f9a4ede6e53957ea81542abe7aa2b0517c5bdd78; git status remained clean. No repository, research-state, server, canonical, schedule, OOS, or Trading mutation occurred.

uncertainty: Primary source B content was inaccessible; its task-described daily cross-sectional world-order-flow scope and findings were not independently verified from primary text.
Sources A and C do not establish that one OKX BTC-USDT spot venue carries predictive information for 15- or 60-minute returns after the frozen entry and control rules.
Cross-venue causal origin, statistical significance, fees, slippage, fills, capacity, PnL, drawdown, OOS behavior, and activation remain MISSING_PROOF.
recommended_next_action: Manager may freeze one READ_ONLY retry of this same three-paper prior audit only after primary source B full text or a readable primary publisher/author page is directly accessible; preserve every V3 byte and do not interpret outcomes, create a hypothesis/candidate, open OOS, deploy, or trade in that retry.
